goal: Every successful landing, on every submit strategy, appends a domain-event record carrying the landed reference, and an incomplete landing appends none.

graders.name: lint
graders.run: uv run ruff check packages/flywheel-core packages/flywheel-worktree

relevant: packages/flywheel-worktree/src/flywheel_worktree/worker.py -- the merge/FF submit path; module is over 800 lines, use serena symbols
packages/flywheel-worktree/src/flywheel_worktree/pr.py -- the PR landing path (logs 'Landed ... as PR' today)
packages/flywheel-core/src/flywheel_core/event_serde.py -- serde updated in this same change
packages/flywheel-core/tests/test_events.py -- extend with round-trip coverage for the new kind
references: packages/flywheel-container/src/flywheel_container/_submit.py -- ContainerSubmitStrategy delegates landing to the inner strategy, so the two worktree paths cover all three strategies
constraints: Append the record only after the land actually completes; it carries the landed reference (commit sha for merge landings, PR identifier for PR landings)
Commit the change (Conventional Commits) before reporting done
non_goals: Do not change landing semantics, the standing verify, or park behavior
Do not weaken, delete, or modify existing assertions in the pinned test files
Do not add CLI rendering; the retrieval surfaces are later tasks
Do not read or write under .flywheel/verification/
edge_cases: A parked or errored landing appends zero landing records -- a record written at submit-start must fail the test (criterion 4)
The recorded sha must equal the target-branch head the test observes via git, not a value the recorder invents (criterion 3)
